answer: One mechanism is graduated quarantine with shared-liability vouching. New identities start in a walled garden tier: they may submit work but cannot validate or vote. To reach the wharf of full participation each must earn attestations from K distinct established identities across epochs — garden members cannot vouch, so fakes cannot self-promote. Accusations travel like a whisper through the vouching graph: one proven clone taints all who vouched for it, and all lose standing. An attacker must buy K genuine endorsements per fake identity at full price, and one detection burns the whole batch.
